name: Batten flies: the season as painted cloths
description: The season’s productions as painted cloths on their pipes, each with its title painted large at its foot, its credit line, its run, an On now / Next / On sale / Closed tag chosen by the date and its buttons. On a large screen each cloth flies in from above as the page scrolls, lands and swings, in front of the last; a rail at the stage’s foot numbers the cues. Stacked one after another on a phone, under reduced motion and while editing.
